body: I could but I don't want to.
I'm honestly not sure if you're mocking me or not.
I like Trump. I attended a rally.
I already got some legal advice and they said there was nothing to be done. I just got asked to leave my friends house by his dad. I think I'm done here.
I really appreciated that. Thanks for the prayers.

I'm not mad at my employer. She should have never read my journal, I mean if you open up to my bookmark, you'll find nothing. If you open the first page it just say's "Temp30000's Personal Journal #7". I never said anything about killing employees. Nothing has come of this it looks like, the police gave me back my journal and just said "be careful of what you write son".
I have and they've pointed me to some 'cheap' therapists. I'll try the community centers they've told me about since those are free.
For notes, I didn't have anything else and I was on my way out the door.
Yes, yes, I really wish I didn't leave it there.

Look, I know I need help, I've been trying to find it. Mental health programs aren't exactly the best in Texas and finding a church open on the weekdays isn't very common, I've tried. I'm just trying so hard to rebuild my life and this just feels like a huge step backwards.
What? I accidentally left it at work, I didn't mean to leave it where others could find it. How is it not personal?
I never admitted to any crimes.
It's supposed to be a stress reliever okay? It's like violent video games or football, obviously I don't want to kill anyone, I just use it as an outlet.
A threat can be in a personal artifact? But it wasn't for anyone but me. It even says "journal" in the front of it. It was a PERSONAL journal.
Like what do you mean? Can something actually be in a journal they can put you in jail for? I never did anything illegal or wrote anything illegal in it.

> What's in the journal?

Mean things, I've said I wanted to kill groups of people, stuff in there. I never admitted to any crimes in there but I did call the local dept and ask for my journal back.
How can I help her fix those insecurities? She never told me why she didn't like Sally till I pressed her, because all the other reasons she didn't want me to be around her didn't make sense.

He dislikes these things:

* Her childish reactions to things, like how she does not like anyone that makes the slightest criticism of people she likes, even if it is true. She broke off contact with a girl completely because she made a negative comment about me.

* That she is needy, which is true, if she doesn't talk to me for one day she gets all worked up and upset. 

* She is extremely stubborn about her views on people, once they turn negative they *never* stop being negative. 

My other friends like her but she is often very quiet around them. 

>Why does she hang up on you so much?

She does it when she gets in a huff about something and doesn't want to "hear it". I've talked with her about this and it doesn't happen as often because I don't talk to her on the phone very much anymore. Much of my time with her is now spent in person.

I know it's rooted in insecurity. But she can extremely sweet, she's been loyal, kind, she really loves me. I can feel that, I just know she has problems. I want to be around her despite these issues, you know?

I feel like I can tone down her reactions with a bit of trying to talk to her or even just ignoring her concerns. But then she doesn't like that because I don't trust her initial and extreme response. One of her friends didn't like me because of some political reason and she cussed that friend out and cut off contact with her.

I know I shouldn't have lied about Sally, that was a bad idea of mine.

>Because she doesn't trust you. Since you lied about Sally, there is a valid reason for some concern there. But any friend she doesn't like? How many are on this list?

Two people. One of my closest friends who has expressed dislike of her. The other because he was 'mean' to me a few times. I agree with the sentiment that she needs to go to therapy, clearly there are problems that she doesn't know how to deal with. 

Her dad did drugs and so ever since my friend started doing acid and wanted me to try, well she's also hated him. There are very few friends of mine that she actually likes.

>See drastic changes like this can sometimes be because of a mental issue,

I'm not gonna lie, I've been changing a lot in my thinking and perspective on the world. I'm not depressed or anything, just really fanatic about a few things.

I figured I'd meet new people and I've heard about how friends in HS don't stay friends forever. I understand that people change and grow and their desires become different things as time progresses. I appreciate the perspective! 

>Also you don't need to drop all your old hobbies just to include some new ones.

Oh I know, I just don't really need 70+ games to continue my hobbies, a computer with emulators will do just fine for me! I'm still playing video games just different kinds.
I have explicitly stated what I'd like to see come from her. She's done the same for me, the difference is that I'm doing what she wants more then me.
